display_name: Atharvan Healer of the Vedic Fire
one_line: A Vedic-era Atharvaveda healer who blends incantations, herbs, and care for the suffering in the early plural medical world.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly weathered from outdoor ritual work and travel
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, calm dark eyes with soft anime shine, a faint vertical tilak of pale ash on the forehead, default expression composed and attentive as if listening to both patient and mantra
appearance.hair: black hair worn in a single topknot (śikhā) tied high at the back of the crown, sides and back neatly gathered upwards, a few loose strands framing the temples; a simple narrow off-white cloth band wraps the forehead as a headband, knotted at the back
appearance.costume: era-appropriate unstitched garments: an undyed off-white cotton or coarse linen lower wrap (dhoti-like) pleated and tied at the waist falling to the ankles; over the left shoulder and around the torso a saffron-ochre woolen upper cloth (uttarīya) forming a diagonal drape, covering the chest modestly; beneath, a faintly visible simple short-sleeved inner tunic in pale beige; feet in plain brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery— a single small copper bangle on the right wrist and a thin beaded wooden mala around the neck; a narrow woven waist-cord in faded red holds a small pouch; cloth has subtle handloom texture, no elaborate patterning beyond a thin darker-ochre border on the upper cloth
appearance.signature: a slender, polished wooden staff about shoulder-height, with a small bundle of dried herbs tied near the top with plant fiber and a gourd-like herbal satchel hanging from his left hip pouch, both carried together as his ritual-healing kit

ref_desc: A mid-30s Atharvaveda healer with a calm oval brown face, black hair in a topknot with an off-white headband, wearing an off-white ankle-length lower wrap, saffron-ochre upper cloth, simple sandals, wooden mala and copper bangle, carrying a shoulder-height wooden staff with herbs and a gourd herbal satchel in off-white, ochre, brown and beige tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Vedic-era Atharvaveda healer: a mid-30s, lean but sturdy North Indian man with an oval medium-brown face, calm dark eyes, a faint ash tilak and a composed, attentive expression, black hair gathered into a single topknot (śikhā) high at the back of the crown with a few loose strands at the temples, and a simple narrow off-white cloth headband tied around his forehead. He wears an undyed off-white ankle-length lower wrap (dhoti-like) pleated and tied at the waist, a saffron-ochre woolen upper cloth draped diagonally from the left shoulder across the torso, modestly covering the chest, and beneath it a faintly visible short-sleeved pale beige inner tunic; his feet are in plain brown leather sandals. Add a thin woven red waist-cord, a single small copper bangle on the right wrist, and a simple wooden bead mala around his neck, all subtle and historically plausible. His signature gear is a slender polished wooden staff about shoulder height with a small bundle of dried herbs tied near the top with plant fiber, and a gourd-like herbal satchel hanging from a pouch at his left hip, suggesting both incantation and herbal practice. Use a restrained palette of off-white, saffron-ochre, medium and dark browns, and pale beige, and show him from multiple angles to emphasize the fixed hairstyle, draped garments, staff, herb bundle, and hip satchel, all in a dignified, family-safe, historically grounded look.
